items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: I had done a record with George in 1999 and he decided to do some of those songs so I got the call.

ctx.x: I had done a record with George in 1999 and he decided to do some of those songs so I got the call. The guy has unbelievable talent. A really great singer. Every night he knocked me out.
What do you like to see from up-and-coming singers as far as taking care of their own business. I mean musical business.
